description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and another model (orange bars)—across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-3K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale. For each dataset, two bars are displayed side-by-side: the blue bar for LLaMA-3-8B-it and the orange bar for the other model. The chart shows that the LLaMA-3-8B-it model generally achieves higher scores than the other model on most benchmarks. For instance, on the GSM-3K dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores approximately 79%, while the other model scores around 80%. On the MMLU dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores about 65%, and the other model scores around 65%. On the HumanEval dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores around 61%, while the other model scores approximately 64%. On the TruthfulQA dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores around 43%, and the other model scores about 60%. On the ARC dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores approximately 59%, and the other model scores around 64%. On the MBPP dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores about 60%, and the other model scores around 60%. On the LC AlpacaEval-2 dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores around 23%, and the other model scores approximately 31%. On the MT-Bench (×5) dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores about 41%, and the other model scores around 42%. On the Chat-Arena-Hard dataset, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores approximately 21%, and the other model scores around 29%. The legend in the top right corner identifies the two models, with the blue bar representing LLaMA-3-8B-it and the orange bar representing the other model. The chart is sorted in descending order of scores for the LLaMA-3-8B-it model.
